content: Yĩsi ɡeerɑ dukiɑ bɑkɑ bɛɛrɛ kere. Bɛɛrɛ yɑ mɑɑ sii ɡeesu kɑ wurɑ kere.
Arumɑniɡii kɑ sɑ̃ɑro, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ be yiru kpuro kuɑ.
Wi u lɑɑkɑri mɔ wiyɑ rɑ ɡbi u kɔ̃sɑ wɑ kpɑ u kuke, ɑdɑmɑ lɑɑkɑri sɑriruɡii u rɑ de u ye wɔriwɑ kpɑ u yen wɑhɑlɑ wɑ.
Tii kɑwɑbu kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn nɑsiɑrun ɑre sɑ̃ɑwɑ dukiɑ kɑ bɛɛrɛ kɑ wɑ̃ɑru.
Sɑ̃ki kɑ yɛ̃ri rɑ n wɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔn kɔ̃son swɑɑ sɔɔ. Wi u win hunden fɑɑbɑ kĩ, wiyɑ rɑ n kɑ yi tondinɛ.
A bii swɑɑ ɡeɑ sɔ̃ɔsio. Ù n kpɛ̃ɑ, u ǹ ye derimɔ.
Gobiɡiiwɑ u rɑ n sɑ̃ɑro nɔmɑ sikerenɛ. Wi u mɑɑ bɔkurɑmɔ u sɑ̃ɑwɑ wi u nùn bɔkurɑmɔn yoo.
Wi u kɔ̃sɑ duurɑ, kɔ̃sɑ u rɑ ɡɛ̃, kpɑ win dɑm dɔrebu bu kpe.
Nuku tiɑɡii u koo domɑru wɑ, domi u rɑ win dĩɑnu kɑ sɑ̃ɑrobu bɔnu ko.
A tɔn yɑɑ kɑsikio ɡiro wunɛn min di, kpɑ sɑnnɔsu kɑ sikirinɔsu kɑ wɔmɑ yu kpe.
Wi u rɑ kɑ̃ win ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ n dɛɛre, kpɑ u n dɑ ɡɑri ɡere kɑ kĩru, sinɑ boko u koo ko win bɔrɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u rɑ yɛ̃ruɡiin ɡere nɔni doke, ɑdɑmɑ u rɑ weesuɡiin ɡere sɔ̃ɔsiwɑ weesu.
Yikuro u rɑ n mɔ̀, u ǹ yɑriɔ tɔɔwɔ, domi ɡbee sunɔ ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi, ɡɑ koo nùn ɡo swɑɑɔ.
Kurɔ tɑnɔn ɡɑri yi sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe suurɑ bɑkɑ. Wi Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ mɔru mɔ̀, wiyɑ u koo wɔri mi.
Bibu bɑ rɑ ɡɑri bɑkɑ kookoosu kɑ̃, ɑdɑmɑ sɛɛyɑsiɑbɑ bu koo de bu su deri.
Wi u sɑ̃ɑro dɑm dɔremɔ win ɡobi yi kɑ kpɛ̃ɑ, kɑ wi u ɡobiɡii ɡɑ̃ɑnu kɛ̃mɔ, be kpurowɑ bɑ tii sɑ̃ɑru kpɛ̃ɛmɔ.
Kirɔ bwese bwesekɑ
A swɑɑ tem kpĩiyɔ kpɑ ɑ bwisiɡibun ɡɑri nɔ. A kɑ ɡɑri yi nɑ nun sɔ̃ɔmɔ sɔmburu koowo.
A yi dokeo wunɛn ɡɔ̃ruɔ kpɑ ɑ n sɔɔru sɑ̃ɑ ɑ kɑ yi ɡere. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, kɑɑ n nuku dobu mɔ.
Nɑ kĩwɑ ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ nɑɑnɛ ko. Yen sɔ̃nɑ kon nun ɡɑri yi sɔ̃ ɡisɔn di mɑm.
Nɑ rɑɑ nun ɡɑri dɑbinu yoruɑ yì sɔɔ bwisi kɑ yɛ̃rɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
Yiyɑ yi koo nun sɔ̃ɔsi ɡeeru sɔ̃ɔsi te kɑɑ nɑɑnɛ ko. Bɑ̀ n nun ɡɑ̃ɑnu bikiɑ, kpɑ ɑ kpĩ ɑ bu wisi dee dee.
A ku sɑ̃ɑron ɡɑ̃ɑnu wɔrɑ win dɑm sɑrirun sɔ̃. A ku mɑɑ wɔnwɔndo dɑm dɔre siri yerɔ.
Domi Yinni Gusunɔ u koo kɑ bu yinɑ, kpɑ u be bɑ ben yɑ̃nu ɡurɑ ɡo.
A ku kɑ mɔruɡii bɔrɔnu ko. A ku mɑɑ kɑ sɑnnɔ kĩro swĩinɑ.
Kɑɑ rɑ win dɑɑ sɑɑri kpɑ ɑ yinɑ wɔri.
A ku ɡoon dibu mwɑ ɑ sɔbe. A kun dɑ n wɑ̃ɑ be bɑ tɔmbu nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑmmɛn wuuru sɔɔ.
Domi ɑ̀ kun mɔ ye kɑɑ kɔsiɑ, bɑɑ wunɛn kpin yeru bɑ koo tɔrubɑ mwɑ.
A ku wunɛn ɡberun kɔɔrɔ susisiɑ ɑ kɑ ɡooɡiɑ mɛnnɛ. A ye nɛnuɔ nɡe mɛ wunɛn sikɑdobɑ bɑ nun deriɑ.
Wi u win sɔmburun ɑsɑnsi yɛ̃, u koo kpĩ u ko sinɑmbun sɔm kowo, kpɑ u kun mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ wi u wɑ̃ɑ bɔkuɔ.
